title: Wedding invitation meetup scheduler (청첩장모임 스케줄러)
domain: group meetup scheduling for engaged couples
problem: Engaged Korean couples must hand-deliver wedding invitations through dozens of small meetups in the ~3 months before the wedding. Grouping acquaintances into meetups is hard (people belong to multiple circles, some require 1:1), and coordinating each group's schedule across messenger chat rooms becomes unmanageable as rooms multiply.
audience: Korean engaged couples (bride and groom using it together, each managing their own acquaintance pool) and their invited acquaintances responding to date polls; 40-100+ invitees, weekends filling up 3 months before the wedding.
coreTasks: Register and manage an acquaintance pool with names, relationship groups, and contacts, allowing one person in multiple groups
Compose meetups by selecting acquaintances into a group
Propose multiple candidate dates to a meetup and collect available/unavailable replies with a reply deadline
Confirm a final date and share it with all meetup members
View all confirmed meetups across both partners' pools in one calendar and spot date conflicts
Track meetup progress states: awaiting replies, ready to confirm, confirmed, completed

features.name: Acquaintance pool management
features.description: Register name, relationship group (university/work/family), contact; one person can belong to multiple groups at once.

features.name: Meetup composition
features.description: Select registered acquaintances and bind them into one meetup; supports 1:1 meetups for relationships like bosses.

features.name: Date polling and reply collection
features.description: Propose multiple candidate dates to meetup members, collect available/unavailable replies, and set a reply deadline.

features.name: Confirmation and sharing
features.description: Once the final date is set, every meetup member can see it.

features.name: Whole-schedule overview
features.description: See all confirmed meetups across the groom-side and bride-side pools at a glance and detect overlapping dates.

features.name: Progress states
features.description: Distinguish meetups awaiting replies, ready to confirm, confirmed, and already held.

constraints: Designed for the couple (two users) together, not a single-user calendar app
Greenfield: no existing screens or design assets; the source PRD deliberately specifies no screen counts, layouts, components, colors, or typography
No paid screen-library sources may be used during research

approval.approvedBy: team-shared example PRD (examples/wedding-scheduler/PRD.md, converted to approved-prd/v1 by stage 2-3 owner; no brand colors/fonts specified upstream)
